data.name: Sakharam
data.gender_notes: Sakharam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sakharam is a name of the Hindu god Skanda, who is also known as Kartikeya. He is the god of war, peace, and victory, and is often depicted as the god of friendship and loyalty. He is also considered a god of protection and is invoked to remove obstacles and to grant success. The name Sakharam carries the meaning “God of Friendship” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sakharam usually hope their child will grow to embody god of friendship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sakharam represents the divine aspect of friendship and loyalty. It reminds us of the importance of these qualities in our relationships and encourages us to cultivate them in our own lives.
data.etymology: Sakharam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Friendship.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sakharam total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: Sakharam as a Hindu name holds significant cultural impact as it is directly related to the god Skanda, who holds immense importance in Hindu mythology. He is one of the sons of Shiva and Parvati, and is considered an embodiment of courage, wisdom, and strength. The name Sakharam is widely used across India and is celebrated in various regional festivals, especially the Skanda Shashti festival. It is a trusted and revered name that signifies loyalty, friendship, victory, and protection.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sakharam holds deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the name of the Hindu god Skanda, who is believed to bring prosperity, peace, and victory in one's life. He is also referred to as the god of compassion, friendliness, and loyalty. The name is not just a mere identification, but it is a divine bond that connects the bearer to the divine power of Skanda. It is believed that invoking the blessings of Lord Skanda through this name brings good fortune, strengthens relationships, removes obstacles, and grants success. The name Sakharam is a constant reminder of the divine presence that guides and protects us in our journey through life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sakharam signifies one who embodies friendship and love. It is a name that evokes feelings of camaraderie and brotherhood, symbolizing a deep connection between individuals. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sakha', meaning friend. It is a name that inspires warmth, trust, and mutual respect.
